# geoai-mcp-eval

> Pre-experiment documentation: does the integration interface (typed MCP tools vs PyQGIS code generation) change the correctness of executed GIS artefacts produced by LLM agents? Status: pre-experiment, not frozen. Nothing in this site is a result.
